entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.934 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 63433 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...671A.163M/abstract); Mass 0.956 +/- 0.022 solar masses from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 63433 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...671A.163M/abstract); temperature from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 63433 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the temperature of Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 63433 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive, through the CIE 1931 2° colour-matching functions (CIE 2019, CC BY-SA 4.0, doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,553 K and log g 4.48: a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
